core_problem_solved: To provide JAXB (Java Architecture for XML Binding) annotation support for the legacy Jackson 1.x JSON library, allowing Jackson's ObjectMapper to process POJOs that were annotated for XML serialization.
key_features: An annotation introspector that enabled Jackson 1.x's `ObjectMapper` to understand and apply standard JAXB annotations (e.g., `@XmlElement`, `@XmlAttribute`).
era_and_niche: A specialized extension module for the legacy Jackson 1.x series, useful for projects that needed to support both JSON and XML serialization with a single set of annotations on their model classes.
reason_for_obsolescence: This artifact is **obsolete**. It is part of the legacy Jackson 1.x ecosystem (`org.codehaus.jackson`), which was completely superseded by Jackson 2.x (`com.fasterxml.jackson`). The modern Jackson 2.x has its own official module for this functionality, called **`com.fasterxml.jackson.module:jackson-module-jaxb-annotations`**.
